We are open to any woman who wants to relate to this land whether she wants to stay full-time, work for the summer, camp and work, spend the weekend, or stay here on the way cross country. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes. --KD & Barb Aehle - Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angles, WA, 98362 - PH. 206 452-2435
